featured_reviews.review_text: Most of the time, we order at home from 'Fries on the Go'. Very rarely do we actually eat there. But the food quality, taste and variety is absolutely amazing. Hygiene is very well maintained. While this is a 100 percent vegetarian food outlet, the taste and variety is highly commendable. So you can enjoy irrespective of your food preference.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Great food, fast service, and pocket-friendly prices. Keep it up!

featured_reviews.review_text:
We went for a late-night dessert run in Kandivali (located right next to the hospital) and found the place absolutely swamped! At 10:30 PM, there was a visible waitlist, with about a 30-minute expected delay.

Fortunately, we spoke to the manager, explaining we only needed a quick dessert fix. They were very accommodating and quickly arranged a table for us outside!
The service was efficient, and the desserts were definitely worth the effort.

We ordered the Cream of Strawberry, Chocolate Tower, and Sinful Strawberry, and all three were delicious.

If you're in the area and craving a late-night treat, I highly recommend it. Just know that you might encounter a crowd!

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Must-Visit for Fusion Veg Delights in Kandivali
Crave Junction in Kandivali truly stands out as a pure-veg haven in Mumbai. Boasting an impressive 17 varieties of sizzlers, it's a unique spot you won't want to miss. Their fusion food creations are simply brilliant; the Guacamole Sev Puri and Thecha Vada Pav Bao were delightful, and the Thecha Paneer Tikki was a hit. After indulging in three fantastic sizzlers, we rounded off the meal with the amazing Filter Coffee Affogato Sundae and Biscoff Tres Leches. The food was just incredible, and with a new ambiance and revamped menu, Crave Junction offers an exceptional dining experience.
